services/bonding: Dental bonding at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Tooth-coloured resin sculpted onto a chipped or uneven tooth by Dr. Dave ChoDMD in one visit, usually with no drilling.
services/bone-grafting: Bone grafting at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Socket preservation, sinus lifts and ridge augmentation by Dr. Dave ChoDMD, rebuilding the jaw so an implant can be placed.

services/composite-fillings: Composite fillings at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Mercury-free resin shaded to your own teeth and bonded to them, placed in one visit by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD.
services/comprehensive-care: Deep cleaning at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Scaling and root planing below the gumline by Dr. Dave ChoDMD, to reverse early gum disease before it takes bone.
services/cosmetic-dentistry: Cosmetic dentistry at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Whitening, porcelain veneers, bonding, crowns and Invisalign combined into one plan by Dr. Dave ChoDMD.
services/crown-lengthening: Crown lengthening at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Reshaping gum and bone by Dr. Dave ChoDMD so a crown has something to hold, or so a gummy smile shows more tooth.
services/dental-crowns: Dental crowns at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Porcelain, zirconia, PFM and gold, prepared and fitted by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, with the estimate in writing first.
services/dental-hygiene-education: Oral hygiene education at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Brushing and flossing technique, product choice, diet and the early signs of gum disease, taught with your cleaning.
services/dental-implant-placement: Dental implant placement at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Single implants, implant-supported bridges and All-on-4, placed by Dr. Dave ChoDMD from imaging of your own jawbone.
services/dental-implant-restorations: Dental implant restorations at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Single teeth, implant-supported bridges and dentures, All-on-4 and All-on-6, planned on 3D imaging by Dr. Dave ChoDMD.
services/dentures: Full, partial, immediate and implant-supported dentures at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX, made to your own measurements by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, with clear pricing at the consultation.
services/emergency-dentist: Emergency dentist in Katy, TX. Same-day appointments and walk-ins at Mason Park Dental, with immediate pain relief, emergency root canals and extractions by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD.
services/extractions: Simple, surgical, wisdom tooth and emergency extractions at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Dr. Dave ChoDMD tries to save the tooth first, and offers sedation when it cannot be saved.
services/fluoride-treatment: Professional fluoride treatment at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. A varnish that hardens enamel and can reverse the earliest decay, applied by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD at a routine visit.
services/frenectomy: Laser frenectomy at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Tongue-tie and lip-tie released in under 15 minutes, no sutures, for infants, children and adults.
services/invisalign: Invisalign clear aligners at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Dr. Dave Cho, DMD plans your treatment on 3D scans, and the price is written down before it starts.
services/invisalign-questions: Twenty-one Invisalign questions answered by Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX — how clear aligners work, comfort, timeline, candidacy, insurance and retainers.
services/laser-dentistry: Laser dentistry at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Gum treatment, frenectomy, cavity removal and gum contouring with focused light instead of a drill, often with no anaesthetic.
services/mouth-guards: Custom mouth guards at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Sports, night and TMJ guards moulded to your own teeth by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, thin enough that you actually wear them.
services/night-guards: Custom night guards for teeth grinding at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Made to your own bite by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, to stop bruxism wearing your enamel and straining your jaw.
services/oral-cancer-screening: Oral cancer screening at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. A few painless minutes at every checkup with Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, because early detection raises five-year survival to 80-90%.
services/porcelain-veneers: Porcelain veneers at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Thin custom ceramic shells bonded to the front of healthy teeth by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, stain-resistant and lasting 10 to 15 years.
services/preventative-dentistry: Preventative dentistry at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Cleanings, exams, digital x-rays, fluoride, sealants and oral cancer screening with Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, for the whole family.
services/root-canal-therapy: Root canal therapy at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Dr. Dave Cho, DMD removes the infection, ends the pain and keeps the tooth, with a success rate over 95%.
services/sealants: BPA-free dental sealants at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Resin painted into the grooves of the back teeth by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, in one painless visit, lasting 5 to 10 years.
services/sedation-dentistry: Sedation dentistry at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Nitrous oxide, oral and IV sedation, monitored throughout, for patients whose fear has kept them away. Dr. Dave Cho, DMD holds a sedation certification.
services/tmj-tmd: TMJ and TMD treatment at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Jaw pain, headaches, clicking and locking diagnosed and treated, almost always without surgery.
services/whitening: Professional teeth whitening at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. In-office whitening in a single visit, or customised take-home trays, lifting years of coffee, wine and smoking stain.
services/wisdom-teeth: Wisdom tooth assessment and removal at Mason Park Dental in Katy, TX. Digital imaging and customised planning by Dr. Dave Cho, DMD, with sedation available. Not every one needs removing.
